scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run db:push -w server -- --skip-generate && npm run db:seed-if-empty -w server && npm start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
